articles.title: Is Ultron Hiding Inside Vision's Head?
articles.summary: The new VisionQuest trailer shows Ultron living inside Vision's mind like a ghost! Remember when Vision zapped him with the Mind Stone? Maybe he didn't destroy him—maybe he saved him. Now they might team up like father and son.

articles.title: The Ground Under Your Feet Is Alive—and Maybe Even Smart!
articles.summary: Scientists found a giant web of fungus under the soil that's longer than you can imagine—enough to stretch to Pluto and back thousands of times! Some think it might even be conscious, like a giant underground brain.

articles.title: Want to Find Buried Treasure? These Metal Detectors Can Help!
articles.summary: A gear expert tested metal detectors on beaches and in parks to find the best ones for beginners and pros. The top pick found a toy buried 6 inches deep in the surf! One kit costs less than $200 and even comes with a digging tool.
